question: A series LCR circuit containing a resistance $R=10 \, \Omega$, an inductance $L=20 \, \text{mH}$, and a capacitance $C$ is connected to an AC source of variable frequency. If the circuit resonates at an angular frequency of $1000 \, \text{rad/s}$, determine the value of capacitance $C$ required.
